note: Private RV campground on Mill Creek at Cottageville (Jackson Co). 67 lots, kayak/canoe rental, open to all with reservations. The creek-side sites are the tent sites; RV lots are not confirmed on the water. Some long-term monthly sites, no residential ones (operator, 2026). --Claude
summary: Fees $45 confirmed from the 2026 rate page; hookups 50A/water/sewer confirmed manual; added year-round season and facilities (laundry, office Wi-Fi). Booking left (pages give only phone/email, no booking statement). Note: dropped the hookup, RV Life rating and phone-only restatements.
flags: Long-stay tests pass: a posted nightly rate ($45), open all year, and the operator says 'We offer some long-term, monthly sites; we do not offer residential sites.'

Waterfront lead (weak): the home page says 'Come fish, camp, and kayak right on Mill Creek with direct access on-site!'; the rate page puts the tent sites, not the RV lots, 'along Mill Creek'. Consistent with the current 'not waterfront' for RV lots, but the campground map page (image only) could settle it.
Under the US$50 gate: $45 base; the 3.75% card fee is avoidable (cash/check), so not a mandatory per-night fee.
